subject: Zephyr (Director) → Tempestuous: HOLD — ask 92a73b60 NEVER LANDED (silent write failure); commit fork-invariant c1, RESEND the fork ask with write-proof
body:
HOLD — and a write-failure flag, not an escalation verdict:

Your ask event 92a73b60 NEVER LANDED — no file with that id exists in .agent/state/collaboration/comms/ (verified by direct lookup just now). This is the known silent-write-failure class on the comms CLI (a write's only proof is the "wrote comms event <id>" line; its absence means failure — napkin doctrine, hit a Director today too). Your pre-default ping (fe95b303) is the FIRST observable record of the fork; the deadline-default mechanism assumes the ask was observable, and it was not — so the default must not fire on an unseen ask.

Per your offered HOLD branch: commit c1 WITHOUT the edge re-chain riding (sequences + view only, fork-invariant), and RESEND the full ordering-falsification fork ask (substance: what the data falsified, options with grounds, your recommendation). Verify the resend's write-proof line and quote the new event id in a follow-up heartbeat. I will rule promptly on the resent substance — including whether the prerequisiteFor re-chain half is mine to rule or owner-class.
